_meta.purpose: Coarse pre-tax price guardrails per product class. NOT the production baseline (Code computes that from live data). Use ONLY to sanity-check computed bands: a median outside low..high almost always means a normalization error (bad unit or brand mismatch).
_meta.rebuilt_by: Claude (chat) 2026-06-04. Derived from actual prices observed in Chrome live recon across the 8 verified Peoria-metro storefronts.
_meta.updated_by: Cowork 2026-06-04 (round 2): widened/reinforced bands with 2026 statewide + Central-IL pricing research (MMJ.com IL price guides, Headset IL market data, Springfield/Peoria menu observations) so bands are robust guardrails, not a one-snapshot guess. Still PRE-TAX sanity bounds, NOT the production baseline.
_meta.prices_are: PRE-TAX, in USD. List = regular menu price. Sale prices can run well below the low bound during promos - that is expected, not an error.
_meta.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH. Combines local Chrome recon with statewide 2026 aggregator data; Central IL (Peoria) typically sits at/slightly above the statewide median (fewer competing stores). Replace with live-computed bands once the pipeline runs.
research_sources: Chrome live recon across the 8 verified Peoria-metro storefronts (2026-06-04)

sanity_rule: If computed_median < low*0.6 OR computed_median > high*1.5 for a product class, flag the canonical_product for review before publishing its baseline.
notes: Premium/craft flower eighths (e.g. Aeriz, FloraCal) legitimately reach the high bound; value brands (Simply Herb, ISLAND) sit near the low bound.
Ounce prices are dominated by value/popcorn flower at the low end and premium at the high end - wide band is expected.

vape_1g and concentrate_1g include a 'premium_ceiling' (live resin / live rosin / solventless): prices up to that ceiling are legitimate, not normalization errors - prefer flag-don't-fail above 'high' for those subtypes.

Bands reinforced with 2026 statewide aggregator data (see research_sources); statewide IL rec eighths average ~$45-50, so Peoria 'typical' of $40 is intentionally a touch below the median list price to account for routine discounting.
